reason: The named lab and the batch report behind the QR code are what I normally go looking for, and magnesium bisglycinate at 200 mg with no oxide is the form I would pick anyway. At the $24.99 launch price I would try one box, since the guarantee means I only risk the first 30 days.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli and I have not seen the lab or its report yet. If the report is not really for my batch, or the lab turns out to be unknown, I walk away.
would_change_my_mind: Opening the QR report and finding a real named lab with a matching batch number and a measured magnesium result.
